title: 第一卷 第19章 陈玄死了第一卷 第20章 杨灰初体验
content_zh:
破财荒芜的村子，已经见不到一个人影，遍地是遭灾的场景，杂草没过半截墙壁，斑驳的墙皮上满是苔藓，雨水冲刷的污垢写满岁月的痕迹。
村外一座破落的小屋内，时不时升腾起淡淡火光，又很快隐没。
陈玄在干床板上打坐。
这里是他来到这个世界的‘出生地’。
初来时已是这般景象，堪堪打猎维持生机，也是常常食不果腹，才抱着试一试的态度进了飞仙门做个杂役。
时隔半年，又回到了这间小破屋。
当真感慨颇多。
这般来回，所求也不过是一个‘活’字，最先想着拜入仙门是怕饿死，只求上仙老爷们赏口饭吃。
后来见识多了，也就想着有朝一日能习得仙法，飞天遁地。
归来，亦是因一个‘活’字。
那苏若烟骄纵妄为，自己落在她手上，迟早得完蛋！
此时，距离他离开飞仙门已经过去十日。
为以防万一，期间他去附近镇上数次打探，确认有无飞仙门杂役弟子逃跑相关的消息，却是半点没打听到。
想来也是，对于飞仙门这种仙门而言，一个杂役弟子死了都不算什么大事，谁会在乎某峰缺了个杂役呢？
至于他丹房的工作，抢着做的大有人在。
想通这些，他也便静下心来安稳修行，打算突破至炼气中期，就去趟仙门弟子常说起的‘灵宝镇’逛逛。
完成此前设想过的第一步：兑换低阶灵晶、买些凡品丹药、搞点法术与阵法相关书籍等等。
借此提升自身实力。
在此期间，他也不忘修习‘混沌炼神诀’，依旧是收获甚微。
原因很简单，这炼神第一步是开辟神识之海，与金丹体系元婴开辟灵府差不多。

可元婴已是金丹体系大佬，识海却不过是元神体系入门。
当然并不是说元神体系就比金丹体系厉害，只是两者主修方向不同，金丹体系更侧重肉身，前几个境界基本都是在锤炼肉体。
而元神体系完全是神识极端，锤炼元神为主，注重精神攻击。
二者最终目的是一样的：合道成仙。
‘混沌炼神诀’光第一步就要吸纳大量天地灵气，炼化为神识，借此填充识海。
可现在陈玄身上只有两颗上品灵晶，自是不敢轻易拿来使用，加上这些时日一直胆战心惊，也不敢轻易外出，便将此事暂且搁置。
早先就听说灵宝镇鱼龙混杂，正统仙门炼气士较少，散修邪修居多，杀人越货的事时有发生，在实力不足的情况下，也不敢贸然前往。
必须做好妥善准备。
念及此处，陈玄闭上双眼继续打坐。
……
飞仙门，丹房。
一道蓝色的流光飞速而至。
换了身靛蓝色长裙的栾清萍跳下飞剑，落在丹房外，径直朝丹房中走去。
探查到有人来，丹房新的负责人快步出门迎了上去，一眼就认出来人，躬身打了个稽首，“见过圣女大人。”
栾清萍止步，看着眼前陌生的青年，问道，“陈玄可在此处？”
“陈玄？”
青年面带疑惑，却不敢敷衍了事，仔细从脑海中搜索这个名字，良久无奈摇头道，“我从未听过此人。”
栾清萍黛眉微蹙，继续说道，“他原先是在这丹房做事，你未曾与他交接？”
content_en:
There is not a single person in the ruined and desolate village. Scenes of disasters are everywhere. Weeds cover half of the walls. The mottled walls are covered with moss. The dirt washed away by rain is full of traces of time.
In a dilapidated hut outside the village, a faint fire rose from time to time, and then quickly disappeared.
Chen Xuan meditated on the dry bed.
This is the 'birthplace' where he came into this world.
It was already like this when I first came here. I could only hunt to stay alive, and I often didn't have enough to eat, so I entered Feixianmen as a handyman with the attitude of giving it a try.
After half a year, I returned to this small shabby house.
I really feel a lot of emotion.
Going back and forth like this, all I wanted was the word "live". The first thing I wanted to do was to worship the Immortal Sect because I was afraid of starving to death, so I just wanted food from the Immortal Masters.
Later, when I saw more, I thought that one day I could learn the magic of immortality and fly to the sky to escape from the earth.
Returning is also due to the word "living".
That Su Ruoyan acted arrogantly and fell into her hands, and she would be finished sooner or later!
At this time, ten days had passed since he left Feixianmen.
Just in case, he went to nearby towns several times to inquire whether there was any news about the escape of Feixianmen's handyman disciples, but he didn't find out at all.
Thinking about it, for an immortal sect like Feixian Sect, the death of a handyman disciple is not a big deal. Who cares if a certain peak is short of a handyman?
As for the work in his alchemy room, there are many people rushing to do it.
After thinking about this, he calmed down and practiced steadily. He planned to break through to the middle stage of Qi refining, so he went to visit the "Lingbao Town" that the disciples of the Immortal Sect often talked about.
Complete the first step that you had imagined before: exchange for low-level spiritual crystals, buy some mortal elixirs, get some books on spells and formations, etc.
Use this to enhance your own strength.
During this period, he did not forget to practice the 'Chaos God Refining Technique', but still achieved little.
The reason is very simple. The first step in refining the spirit is to open up the sea of ​​consciousness, which is similar to the way the Nascent Soul in the golden elixir system opens up the spiritual palace.
But Yuanying is already a master of the Jindan system, but Consciousness Sea is just an entry into the Yuanshen system.
Of course, this does not mean that the Yuan Shen system is more powerful than the Golden elixir system, but the two have different majors. The Golden elixir system focuses more on the physical body, and the first few realms are basically about tempering the physical body.
The Yuan Shen system is completely extreme in spiritual consciousness, focusing on tempering the Yuan Shen and focusing on spiritual attacks.
The ultimate goal of both is the same: to become an immortal by combining the Tao.
The first step of the 'Chaos God Refining Technique' is to absorb a large amount of spiritual energy from heaven and earth and refine it into divine consciousness, thereby filling the sea of ​​consciousness.
But now Chen Xuan only has two high-grade spiritual crystals on his body, so he does not dare to use them easily. In addition, he has been frightened these days and does not dare to go out easily, so he put the matter aside for the time being.
I had heard earlier that Lingbao Town was a mixed bag, with fewer orthodox immortal qi practitioners and more casual cultivators and evil cultivators. Murder and extortion occurred from time to time. I didn't dare to go there rashly even if I didn't have enough strength.
Proper preparation must be made.
Thinking of this, Chen Xuan closed his eyes and continued to meditate.
…
Feixianmen, alchemy room.
A stream of blue light came quickly.
Luan Qingping, who had changed into an indigo dress, jumped off the flying sword, landed outside the alchemy room, and walked straight into the alchemy room.
Upon detecting that someone was coming, the new person in charge of the alchemy room quickly went out to greet him. He recognized the person at a glance, bowed and said, "I have met the Holy Lady."
Luan Qingping stopped, looked at the strange young man in front of her, and asked, "Is Chen Xuan here?"
"Chen Xuan?"
The young man looked puzzled, but he did not dare to be perfunctory. He carefully searched for the name in his mind. After a long time, he shook his head helplessly and said, "I have never heard of this person."
Luan Qingping frowned slightly and continued, "He used to work in this alchemy room, but you never handed over to him?"
